## What's new

- **Much faster Drime backups.** Uploads no longer wait on each other while
  folders are created in Drime. On real data a backup went from about 4–5 to
  about 27–35 files a second.

- **Backups pick up where they left off.** Finished files are saved as the
  backup goes, so a backup that is stopped, crashes or loses power carries on
  from there next time instead of starting over. If no schedule is set, the
  tray app carries on by itself.

- **Pause and resume.** Pause a running backup from the panel, with
  `r2b pause` / `r2b resume`, or with <kbd>p</kbd> in the terminal app. Files
  already uploading finish first.

- **A time left estimate.** The panel shows how long a backup has left once
  it has enough to go on, along with "X of Y files · A of B GB".

- **Network outages wait instead of failing.** If the internet drops, the
  backup waits for it to come back (up to two hours) and carries on. Time
  asleep does not count toward the estimate.

- **Pick a Drime workspace and folder.** Choose which Drime workspace and
  folder backups go to from the panel, or with
  `r2b drime workspaces|folders|use`.

- **Copy your Drime folders to S3.** A new **Secondary backup only** option
  copies folders already in Drime to your S3 storage, for people who use the
  Drime app and want a second copy. Set it up in the panel or with
  `r2b setup purpose copy`.

- **More schedule choices.** Back up every few minutes or hours, or once a
  day at a set time (Windows), from the Settings dropdown or with
  `r2b schedule every|daily|off`.

- **Secondary backup per folder.** Each folder has its own switch for the
  secondary backup, and you choose whether turning it off keeps or deletes
  that folder's copy. In the terminal: `r2b mirror folder <set> on|off
  [--delete]`.

- **A cleaner panel.** The status and **Back up now** sit in a card at the
  bottom. **Add folder** is next to **Restore**, Activity has a **Clear**
  button (`r2b activity clear`), and Settings has **Check for updates**,
  **Import/Export** and what you use r2backup for. New setups back up
  automatically and start with Windows by default.

- **More S3 choices.** Secondary backup can be Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2,
  Amazon S3 or any other S3 storage.

## Fixed

- **Deleting a big Drime folder could hang.** It is now deleted in one
  request, and r2backup checks the folder is gone if Drime is slow to answer.
  No Drime request waits more than five minutes.

## Heads up

- **Wording changed.** "Second copy" is now **Secondary backup**, and your
  main backup is the **Primary backup**. Nothing to do; your settings carry
  over.
- **Drime can no longer be the secondary backup, and Pack small files is off
  for Drime.** Existing S3-only setups keep working as before.
